name: Voltaic Cyclosword

passives.name: Energized
passives.effects: Moving and basic attacking generates Energize stacks, up to 100.

passives.name: Galvanize
passives.effects: Energized stack generation is increased by 75% for distance travelled from dashes, lunges and blinks, as well as while moving in stealth.

passives.name: Firmament
passives.effects: When fully Energized, your next basic attack deals 100 bonus physical damage on-hit and slows the target by (99% /20%) for 0.75 seconds.

description:
55 Attack Damage
10 Lethality
10 Ability Haste

Galvanize
Damaging an Enemy Champions with an ability triggers Energized if it is ready.

Firmament
Your Energized Attack deals % target's Current Health as bonus physical damage and grants you bonus Lethality for 4 seconds.
